doctrine: Operating manual for Adobe creative production stack (Firefly, Frame.io, Express, video/audio generation). Core doctrine: right tool at each stage of workflow beats single-tool attempts. Firefly Image Model 4 default, Model 4 Ultra for photoreal portraits/complex humans. Prompt formula: subject + action + angle + lighting + background + color + style + image type. Firefly Video: Image to Video (best quality with reference), Text to Video (B-roll), Text to Avatar (talking heads). Minimum 8 words for video, 3-word minimum for image but more = precision. Frame.io benchmark: 2-3x faster than unmanaged workflows (Slack/email/folders). Key move: Collections + metadata filters instead of flat folders. Express: Brand Kits lock logos/colors/layouts; non-creatives can edit copy/swap images only. Firefly Services APIs handle batch personalization (Generative Match, Generative Expand, background removal). Custom Models for signature looks; Style Kits for lighter preset sharing. Content Credentials (C2PA) automatic on Firefly output = tamper-evident metadata for commercial safety. IP indemnification available on select Enterprise workflows only (not assumed). Camera to Cloud enables same-day event delivery (proxy to Frame.io during shoot). Workflow chains: (1) hero asset loop = Firefly > Photoshop > Express > Frame.io > approve > deliver; (2) video = frames > Firefly Video > assemble > generate soundtrack/SFX > upload > approve > export; (3) personalization at scale = hero > Firefly Services APIs > Custom Model/Style Kits > Express batch > Frame.io > deliver; (4) live recap = C2C cameras > Editor real-time pull > Firefly for missing B-roll > Frame.io review > same-day export. What to avoid: cartoon + photoreal combo; vague prompts; no Style References when brand look exists; shared cloud folders for review; hand-generation of 100s when APIs exist; assuming all Firefly is IP-indemnified; setting up C2C on event day (test week before).

workflows: Campaign hero asset: Firefly Model 4 Ultra > generate 5-10 > refine in PS > Express Brand Kit resize > Frame.io metadata tag > stakeholder comment > revise > move to Final > branded Share deliver

Branded video campaign: Firefly frames (first/last) > Firefly Video Image to Video > B-roll via Text to Video > optional frame chaining for length > Firefly Video Editor assemble > generate soundtrack > add SFX + speech > Frame.io review > final export

Personalization at scale: Hero asset > Firefly Services APIs (Generative Expand/Match) > Custom Model or Style Kits > Express batch templates > Frame.io batch metadata > approval by Collection > deliver via Share or AEM

Same-day event recap: Camera to Cloud setup (test pre-event) > real-time proxy to Frame.io > editor pulls clips > Firefly Video Text to Video for missing B-roll > layered/transparent elements in AE > Premiere assemble > Frame.io review > same-day deliver
prompts: Image formula: [Subject] [Action] [Angle] [Lighting] [Background] [Color palette] [Style] [Image type] + camera settings if photoreal
Video formula: [Visual style] [Subject] [Action] [Location] [Lighting] [Color grade] [Shot Size] [Camera Angle] [Camera Motion] [Aesthetic] (min 8 words)
Sound effect: [descriptive adjective] [sound source], [additional descriptor] e.g. 'heavy rain on metal roof'
Speech: Apply emotion to full sentences not words; spell out numbers/currencies; uppercase=letters spoken; match prompt language to voice language; no brackets

operating_rules: Default to Firefly Model 4; only use Ultra for photoreal precision or human detail
Match Effect choice to prompt text (e.g. 'Simple Line Doodle' in both Effect and prompt)
Use Style Reference or Composition Reference when brand look/layout exists
3-5 iterations normal; if same error repeats, prompt fights controls settings
Video minimum 8 words; more detail = more precision
Image minimum 3 words but output quality improves significantly beyond
Generate at 1080p from start if final needs hi-res; don't upscale
Frame.io Collections + metadata instead of flat folders (3.6x faster retrieval)
Brand Kits lock logos/colors/safe zones; unlock copy/product/date/location
Frame-chaining for longer videos: generate, take last frame, use as next start frame
Vague prompts like 'beautiful sunset' produce slop; use formula with details
Firefly is one-shot per prompt; no follow-up messages
Align Soundtrack vibe first, style second (calm + heavy metal = unpredictable)
Spell out numbers/currencies in speech prompts (€20 = 'twenty euros')
Uppercase letters pronounced as letters (POC = Pee-Oh-See); lowercase as word
Provide first frame AND last frame reference for video coherence jump
Camera to Cloud only works on compatible WiFi cameras/iPhone apps; test pre-event
IP indemnification on Enterprise plans only, select workflows, read Legal FAQs
Content Credentials tamper-evident but don't assume all Firefly output is IP-covered
content_ideas: Frame.io Collections reduce asset retrieval time 3.6x vs spreadsheet+folder workflows
Camera to Cloud enables competitive advantage: same-day event delivery vs traditional review cycles
Custom Models beat Style Kits when campaign requires signature look at volume (unlimited variations without prompt gymnastics)
Express Brand Kits solve 'creative team becoming meme service for org' problem via lockable templates
Firefly Services APIs replace hand-generation workflow: 1 hero asset into 1000 variants automatically
Content Credentials C2PA differentiates in regulated industries (media, publishing, finance) where AI provenance contractually required
weird_gold: Foley trick: record yourself clapping/tapping in rhythm with on-screen action, then generate matching SFX and align to recording for natural sync
Keyframe Cropping in video controls manual crop area over time when auto-center crop cuts off important elements
Firefly Sound Effects can't do music/melody/singing but handles human sounds (coughs, sneezes) + ambient chatter + percussive hits
Seamless loops: upload first AND last frame of loop to same prompt, Firefly bridges the gap with generated in-between frames
Seeds: same prompt + same settings + same seed = similar output; change seed for variation with same instructions
